evidence.detail: Reviewed the exact base-to-target diff, including the server, UI shell, tests, README, issue record, status record, handoff, and prior review record.
The unit-test command ran 10 tests: five helper tests passed and all five integration tests errored because the sandbox prohibited binding a loopback socket. Exit status 1.
The required compile command could not complete because Python attempted to create scripts/__pycache__ in the read-only checkout. Exit status 1.
The governance validator could not complete because no writable temporary directory was available. Exit status 1.
The required manual server-and-curl check could not be performed because socket binding is prohibited in the review sandbox.

Static inspection found a loopback-only server factory, exact Host allowlisting, an Origin helper, explicit static routes, WEB_ROOT containment, and no authentication, Graph access, token handling, third-party dependencies, or outbound network calls.
The diff hygiene check found trailing whitespace in the implementation plan.

evidence: Expected: the issue's required compile, test, and manual-run checks execute successfully against the exact reviewed SHA, with independently verifiable results.

Observed: tests exited 1 after five socket-binding errors; compile exited 1 because bytecode output was prohibited; the manual run was unavailable; governance validation also exited 1 because no writable temporary directory exists.
AGENTS.md requires BLOCKED when non-security evidence is missing or cannot be verified and explicitly forbids PASS when execution failed.
findings.remediation: Provide a review environment that preserves the read-only candidate while allowing isolated writable bytecode/temp output and loopback sockets, or obtain an exact human decision changing the evidence gate. Then rerun every required check against this exact commit. Author-reported out-of-band results alone are not independent review evidence.

limitations: The sandbox prohibits loopback socket binding, so the HTTP integration tests and manual server check could not be independently verified.
The read-only checkout prevents the specified py_compile command from writing __pycache__.
No writable temporary directory is available, preventing the governance validator from completing.
The handoff's out-of-band check claims are author claims rather than independently reproduced evidence and are not precisely bound to the reviewed SHA.
Static inspection did not reveal a product-code correctness or security defect, but runtime behavior cannot be accepted without the missing execution evidence.
Live authentication and Microsoft Graph behavior are outside ISSUE-0001 scope and were not tested.
review.summary: The exact candidate and base identities are confirmed, and static inspection found a coherent, scoped loopback server shell. The review is BLOCKED because the required compile, integration, manual-run, and governance evidence cannot execute in this read-only/socket-restricted environment. The repaired candidate also retains contradictory workflow state and stale placeholder-bound handoff records, plus a minor whitespace defect. Any correction creates a new candidate and requires fresh checks and review.
